characters.name: The Fisherman’s Son
characters.prompt: A determined young Norwegian man from the 15th century, modest but strong build, dressed in simple woolen trousers and tunic, a small leather belt pouch at his waist, slightly messy hair, and a focused yet kind expression.

characters.name: The Fisherman (Father)
characters.prompt: An older, weather-beaten Norwegian man with a lined face, wearing a heavy wool coat, simple leather boots, and a coarse hat. He stands by a rustic wooden fishing boat, net in hand, reflecting a humble lifestyle of Norway in the early 1400s.

characters.name: The Fisherman’s Wife (Mother)
characters.prompt: A warm, caring woman of Norwegian coastal heritage in the 1400s, dressed in a long, homespun linen gown and apron, her hair partly covered by a simple headscarf, exuding a gentle, worried expression.

characters.name: The King
characters.prompt: A regal figure draped in a fur-lined cloak and simple crown, reflecting Norwegian royalty in the late medieval era. He sits in a wooden hall adorned with weaving hangings, embodying both nobility and rustic charm.

characters.name: The Old Man With the White Beard
characters.prompt: A mysterious elder with a flowing white beard reaching his waist, dressed in tattered yet dignified Norwegian wool garments. He leans on a wooden staff and radiates wisdom, standing on a white, sandy shore.

characters.name: The Youngest Princess of Hvittenland
characters.prompt: A graceful Norwegian princess with flowing, pale blonde hair, dressed in an elegant embroidered gown that reflects the pristine beauty of the 15th century. A serene, gentle demeanor, partially hidden by Nordic surroundings.

characters.name: The Older Princesses
characters.prompt: Two regal sisters clad in similar medieval Norwegian gowns, partially stuck in the ground up to their waists. They appear longing and hopeful, their hair styled in traditional braided fashions.

characters.name: The Trolls
characters.prompt: Grotesque, hulking creatures with multiple heads and gnarled features, clad in ragged fur, looming inside a dim stone castle. Their presence evokes both danger and a sense of ancient Nordic magic.

cleanedMainImagePrompt: Illustrate a grand Norwegian folk scene between 1400 and 1850: a remote coastal village by a glimmering fjord, featuring a modest fisherman’s hut near a majestic wooden castle. Show the fisherman’s son bravely entering an old stone fortress, confronting multi-headed trolls, while three princesses stand partially freed from the earth. Incorporate medieval Norwegian garments, wooden boats, and rustic landscapes for an authentic old-world ambiance.
modernMainImagePrompt: A modern reimagining of the same story set along Norway’s contemporary coastline: depict a bustling fishing harbor with colorful, modest houses and motorboats. The hero wears jeans and a thick jacket, meeting three sisters dressed in stylish Nordic outerwear. The trolls appear in an urban construction site tower or hidden inside a modern industrial complex. Include Norwegian flags, sleek buildings, and everyday technology as background elements.
childMainImagePrompt: A bright, friendly illustration set in a magical Norwegian fairy-tale world for a 5-year-old: depict a smiling young hero wearing simple clothes and holding a wooden fishing rod, three princesses popping out of the earth like flowers, and silly-looking trolls with funny grins. Make everything colorful, with gentle shapes and cozy details in a safe, whimsical forest, and a charming castle in the distance.
simplifiedMainImagePrompt: Lag et oppdatert norsk eventyrbilde: Skildre en norsk kystlinje med en liten fiskerhytte og et trehus-slott i bakgrunnen. En modig ung mann står klar med et sverd, mens tre prinsesser løftes opp fra jorden, og de rare trollene lurer i skumringen. Bruk rolige farger og et middelaldersk, men enkelt norsk landskap.
englishMainImagePrompt: Create a classic fairy-tale illustration capturing the essence of old Norway: display a rugged coastline with a modest fisherman’s cottage, an imposing wooden castle nearby, and a courageous young man facing monstrous trolls. Three princesses emerge from the ground, each more hopeful than the last. Emphasize medieval Norwegian dress, timber architecture, and the mystical atmosphere of a long-ago land.
